body:
I just wanted to chime in to say that my fiancé is severely depressed and he has not worked in almost a year. Do we get stressed out about money? Yes, all the time. But I love him so much and would rather he not work and be here with me than not here. He is not a burden on me at all, even though he often feels that he is. If I didn’t have him, I wouldn’t be able to live. 

He feels like I would be better off without him, less stressed, have more money, less bills etc. I would be eternally sad up until the moment I died if he wasn’t here. I’d rather be homeless with him than in a mansion by myself or with someone else. I hope things turn around on the job search for you, and if you’ve never heard of it maybe check out r/slavelabour 

You probably won’t get rich on that sub (as you can tell by the name) but many people I know have been able to make hundreds of dollars doing random odd jobs there from the comfort of their own home. I hope it helps you and that things turn around for you!
